what_happened: Scene L6: green sponge_4 on a granite counter, lying right against the long right edge of a dark cutting_board_2 (holed board); the sponge spawned touching the board. Stage 0: the gripper came down over the sponge with the left finger directly at/over the board's raised edge (wrist view 108-124). It closed 112-128, and the fingers went down to 0.043 then 0.019, narrower than the sponge (0.058 when held), so it was pinched only at its top edge. The sponge flipped up on its side (tilt 15 deg at 128, 41 deg at 132; 1.5 cm lift) and fell back flat on the counter at ~136, while the fingers closed on air (0.004 at 132). Stage 0 held only at 121 and 128-130. The counter logged 1 'contact' at 128 because the sponge was pressed against the board while momentarily 'grasped'. The gripper stayed closed to 800. 168-320 the policy made scrubbing-like passes over the board with the empty, closed gripper, came back near the sponge at ~360 without opening, then raised the arm and looked around 400-800.
causal_chain: sponge spawned flush against the board edge -> left finger landed on/against the board edge, so the fingers pinched only the sponge's top edge -> sponge flipped out (lift 1.5 cm) and the fingers closed on air at ~132 -> empty-handed 'scrub' over the board 168-320 -> no re-grasp, wandered to 800
official_criterion_notes: Counter contacts=1 although the sponge was never really held: the 'contact' at 128 is the sponge being pressed against the board's edge during the failed pinch. Harmless here.
uncertain_about: Whether the finger actually rested on top of the board edge or only touched its side; either way, the board next to the sponge kept the fingers from closing around the sponge's full height.
